_readme: Firsts with Sam: until a lady has crossed a line with Sam, private time with him only offers services up to that point (services.json → tier: 1 kissing & touching, 2 hands & mouth, 3 everything). Clients aren't affected.
stages: the three lines. label shows on her sheet; situation is passed to the AI writer for that first.

paces: trust she needs for stage 1/2/3, and gap = weeks between her firsts. pentTrust: how much less trust a lady at max lust needs (she pushes past her own pace). holdWeeks: how long she waits after Sam says 'not yet'.

chance: odds per week that a ready lady's first happens on its own (pent = she's at max lust; init = she makes the first move; week = everyone else). It can also happen at the end of a good date, or from 'Take the next step' on her sheet.

characters.<key>: pace (fast/normal/slow), path (the stages her firsts reach, in order: [1,2,3], [1,3], [2,3] or [3]), init (makes the move herself), events keyed by stage, and optionally pent keyed by stage for when she can't wait. Guests from guests.json can be added here too, by key.

Event: title, text (the setup), image {comp, setting, sam, pov, towel} (a picture for this moment), go / goRes (crossing the line; then the service's own line and her reaction follow), wait / waitRes (Sam says not yet), optional act (which service to show; must be at that stage), optional situation (AI prompt context). {name} = her name.

templates: for ladies without their own. Keys 1, 2, 3, jump (from nothing straight past a first kiss), and pent_<key> versions. Optional pers / traits / race lists narrow a variant to matching ladies (they're picked more often when they match).
roll: how pace / path / init are rolled for ladies without their own (generic ladies at random; guests seeded by key so they're the same every game). mods by trait or personality add weight.
relaxed: the bath / walk-in beats of partner stories once she and Sam have reached stage relaxedAt: no more embarrassment. Choices use the arc effect schema (t/m/l, res with {N}).

lewdEase: lewdness eases the trust gate for her firsts. Trust needed for a stage drops by per x (lewd - from), at most max (live: uses her current lewdness; firstNeed() in firsts.js; combines with pentTrust).
roll.lewdPath: when a generic lady's lewdness is at least 'at' as her firsts are rolled, these weights are added to the path odds (on top of the existing lewd >= 60 fast / < 20 slow pace nudge).

templates: a variant may carry lewdMin (0-100): it only applies to ladies with lewdness >= lewdMin, and counts as a matching variant (picked more often). Variants without lewdMin stay usable for everyone.

characters.<key>.events.jump (optional): her own scene for going straight from nothing past a first kiss; used instead of her stage scene when she has no firsts yet. Guests can have events without pace/path/init (those stay rolled).

1.label: First kiss
1.situation: This is their very first kiss; it stays at kissing and touching.

2.label: Going further
2.situation: This is the first time they've gone further than kissing, though not all the way.

3.label: First night
3.situation: This is their first night together.

defaults.waitRes: {name} nods. She doesn't seem upset. If anything, she looks like she's already planning the next time.

text: Sam opens the washroom door and finds {name} in the tub. She doesn't so much as reach for a towel. "Close the door," she says. "From the inside."
{name} is soaking in the bath when Sam walks in by mistake. She just smiles and shifts over to make room.

choices.label: Join her
choices.res: The water's perfect. {N} says so, several times.

text: {name} walks into the washroom while Sam's in the tub, doesn't even pause, and sits on the edge with her feet in the water. "Scoot over."
{name} wanders in while Sam's bathing, hands him a towel he didn't ask for, and stays to chat like it's the most natural thing in the world. For them, it is.

choices.label: Scoot over
choices.res: There isn't really room for two. They make it work.

choices.label: "Some privacy?"
choices.res: {N} laughs, kisses the top of his head, and leaves him to it.

1.title: {name}: A Quiet Moment
1.text: Sam walks {name} back to her room after a long shift. At her door she stops, turns, and just looks at him for a moment, like she's deciding something.

image.comp: standing at her bedroom door, turned toward him, looking up at him with a soft hesitant smile
image.setting: lantern-lit upstairs hallway at night

1.goRes: She meets him halfway. It's brief, and then it isn't.
1.waitRes: {name} smiles, a little disappointed, a little relieved. "Goodnight, Sam."

1.title: {name}: Under the Eaves
1.text: A sudden downpour traps Sam and {name} under the eaves out back. She's laughing, soaked, shoulder to shoulder with him, and then she isn't laughing anymore.

image.comp: sheltering under wooden eaves in the rain beside him, soaked and laughing, leaning closer
image.setting: back alley in heavy rain, lantern light, wet cobbles

1.goRes: The rain doesn't stop. They don't notice.
1.wait: Make a run for the door
1.waitRes: They sprint inside, dripping. {name} keeps glancing at him all evening.

1.title: {name}: Bold Move
1.text: {name} plants herself in front of Sam in the hallway. "I'm going to kiss you now," she announces. "Objections?"

image.comp: blocking a hallway with hands on her hips, confident flirtatious grin, leaning toward him
image.setting: lantern-lit hallway of a pleasure house

1.waitRes: "Overruled. Later." She winks and saunters off.

1.title: {name}: Very Brave
1.text: {name} has been hovering near Sam all evening. Finally she tugs his sleeve, closes her eyes, and goes up on her toes, shaking a little.

image.comp: on tiptoe with eyes squeezed shut, tugging his sleeve, deeply blushing, trembling slightly
image.setting: quiet corner of a lantern-lit lounge

1.goRes: It's barely a kiss. She looks like she might float away.
1.waitRes: She opens her eyes, mortified, then relieved. "...Thank you. Next time. Maybe."

1.title: {name}: A Gift for You
1.text: {name} hands Sam a small wrapped package. While he fumbles with the ribbon she leans in and kisses his cheek. Then, considering, not his cheek.

image.comp: leaning in to kiss him as he unwraps a small gift, playful sly smile
image.setting: cozy lounge, warm lantern light

1.goRes: The gift is a bookmark. He doesn't find out until much later.
1.waitRes: "Open it, then." She laughs and leaves him to it.

1.title: {name}: Elegant Timing
1.text: {name} chooses her moment carefully: a balcony, a view, the last light of evening. "I prefer not to leave these things to chance," she says.

image.comp: on a balcony at sunset, turning toward him with calm poise, one hand on the railing
image.setting: balcony overlooking a fantasy town at sunset

1.goRes: It's exactly as composed and lovely as she planned. Then less composed.
1.waitRes: "Of course." She inclines her head, entirely unruffled. "There will be other sunsets."

1.title: {name}: Off the Clock
1.text: {name} has spent the night smiling at strangers. Afterward she finds Sam in the kitchen and sits down across from him, chin in her hand. "You know what's strange?" she says. "I've lost count of the men I've kissed this month. And I'm nervous."

image.comp: sitting across a small kitchen table late at night, chin in her hand, looking at him with a nervous, unguarded smile
image.setting: house kitchen after closing, a single lantern, two cups of tea

1.goRes: It's nothing like work. She seems as surprised by that as he is.
1.waitRes: {name} laughs, relieved and a little disappointed. "Nobody's ever said that to me before."

1.title: {name}: Lantern Duty
1.text: Closing time, and {name} has asked Sam to help her put out the lanterns along the front walk. One by one the lights go dark, and the street grows quiet and blue. At the last lantern she stops with her hand on the glass. "I always leave this one for last," she says. "It gives me an excuse to stand next to you."

image.comp: standing beside a hanging lantern, hand on the glass, looking up at him with a shy warm smile
image.setting: front walk of the house at night, lanterns half out, blue dusk

1.goRes: She turns her face up, and the last lantern goes out on its own, or maybe neither of them was looking.
1.waitRes: {name} laughs under her breath and hooks her arm through his. "Next lantern, then."

1.title: {name}: Flour on Her Cheek
1.text: {name} is up to her elbows in bread dough in the kitchen at dawn, and there is flour on her cheek, her nose and one eyebrow. Sam reaches out to brush it off. Her breath catches. "You missed a spot," she whispers, though he hasn't missed any, and she is looking at his mouth.

image.comp: close to him at a kitchen worktable, flour on her cheek, looking at his mouth, hands covered in dough
image.setting: warm house kitchen at dawn, flour dust in the light

1.goRes: She leaves two floury handprints on his hoodie, and neither of them cares.
1.waitRes: She lets him wipe her cheek, blushing furiously, and pretends not to be disappointed. The bread, unattended, is slightly burned.

1.title: {name}: Rooftop Stars
1.text: {name} has dragged a blanket up to the roof, the only place in the house where the noise can't follow. The tiles are still warm from the day, the stars very sharp. She pats the spot next to her. When Sam sits, she leans her head on his shoulder, then tips her chin up. "Just checking something," she says.

image.comp: sitting on a rooftop blanket under the stars, head on his shoulder, tipping her chin up to him
image.setting: rooftop of the house at night, warm tiles, bright stars

1.goRes: She was checking. It checks out. She says so, twice.
1.waitRes: "That one's the Cup," she says, a little hoarse, and keeps her head on his shoulder anyway.

1.title: {name}: Mending
1.text: Sam's hoodie has a torn cuff, and {name} takes it from him without a word and sits in the lamp-glow with her needle and thread. The room is hushed. When she bites off the thread, she looks up, holds the sleeve out, and doesn't let go of it when he takes hold. "All fixed," she says softly. "But I'm not done."

image.comp: sitting in lamplight with a needle and thread, holding the sleeve of his hoodie, looking up at him through her lashes
image.setting: quiet sewing corner by the lamp, evening, baskets of thread

1.goRes: She pulls him down by the repaired sleeve. The stitching holds beautifully.
1.waitRes: "Anytime," she says, and finishes the sleeve with a very satisfied little smile, as if she already has a plan.

1.title: {name}: Winner Takes
1.text: {name} has beaten Sam at cards for the fourth night in a row. "You owe me a stake," she says, collecting the coins, then leaving them where they lie. She leans over the table until the candle flickers. "Unless you'd like to pay in another way."

image.comp: leaning across a card table toward him, a hand of cards held up, sly confident smile
image.setting: common room card table at night, candle, scattered coins

1.goRes: The candle goes out. Nobody relights it.
1.waitRes: "Oh, I like that." She shuffles slowly, eyes on him. "I'll collect next time."

2.title: {name}: Further
2.text: {name} pulls Sam into her room after a long day and closes the door. "I've been thinking about more than kissing," she admits. "A lot more."

image.comp: leaning back against a closed door in a dim bedroom, pulling him close by his hoodie, heated eyes
image.setting: small cozy bedroom at night, one candle

2.goRes: She has, in fact, been thinking about it a lot.
2.waitRes: "It is." She kisses him once more, slowly. "Next time, though."

2.title: {name}: Late Night
2.text: Sam can't sleep. Neither can {name}, apparently; she's sitting on the end of his bed when he looks up. "I had an idea," she says.

image.comp: sitting on the end of a bed in the dark, leaning toward him with a sly smile, candle beside her
image.setting: his bedroom late at night, one candle

2.goRes: She doesn't tell him. She demonstrates.
2.waitRes: "Boring." She tucks the blanket around him and leaves him wide awake.

2.title: {name}: Curious
2.text: {name} has questions. Very specific questions. She asks them in a rush, red to the ears, and then: "Could you... show me?"

image.comp: sitting on a bed hugging a pillow, red to the ears, curious earnest eyes on him
image.setting: quiet bedroom, afternoon light through curtains

2.waitRes: "Right. Yes." She buries her face in the pillow.

2.title: {name}: Not Done Yet
2.text: {name} stops Sam mid-kiss. "I'm not done," she says, and pushes him back onto the sofa.

image.comp: pushing him back onto a lounge sofa, standing over him with a challenging grin
image.setting: empty lounge after hours, low lanterns

2.waitRes: "Coward." She laughs and drags him upstairs instead... to say goodnight. Pointedly.

2.title: {name}: Not Like Work
2.text: "I know how to do this," {name} says, her hands at Sam's collar. "I'm very good at it. That's the problem." She stops. "With you I don't want to be good at it. I just want it to be us."

image.comp: standing close in her room, her hands resting on his collar, hesitating, eyes searching his face
image.setting: her bedroom at night, soft lamplight, the door closed

2.goRes: She stops performing halfway through, starts laughing, and doesn't let go of him.
2.waitRes: "Okay," says {name}, and means it. She keeps her hands on his collar a while longer anyway.

2.title: {name}: Warm Hands
2.text: It is a cold night, and {name} has brought Sam a hot cup of spiced wine, which she then sets aside. She takes his hands in hers and rubs the warmth back into them, slowly, thumb by thumb. Her eyes stay on his face. "Your hands are always cold," she says. "I'd like to know where else."

image.comp: holding both of his hands between hers by the fireplace, rubbing them warm, heated look
image.setting: small parlor with a crackling fire, winter night

2.goRes: She finds out thoroughly, and keeps his hands warm all night.
2.waitRes: "Coward," she whispers, with a smile, and warms them against her cheek instead.

2.title: {name}: The Bath Is Big Enough
2.text: The bathhouse is empty, the steam rising off the water in soft white curls. {name} stands at the edge in a robe, one foot testing the temperature, and glances back over her shoulder. "It's a large bath," she says, as if the thought has only just occurred. "Plenty of room for two. You look like you need it."

image.comp: at the edge of a steaming bath in a loose robe, glancing back at him over her shoulder, inviting
image.setting: private bathhouse at night, steam, paper lanterns

2.goRes: The water is hot and the company is warmer, and neither of them hurries out.
2.waitRes: "Brave, noble Sam," she says, and sinks in with a sigh, tossing him a towel. "Don't look. Or do."

2.title: {name}: Hands and Hesitation
2.text: {name} sits on the edge of the bed with her hands in her lap, twisting the fabric of her sleeve. "I've been thinking about kissing," she says carefully. "And then about what comes after kissing. And then I stopped thinking about anything else." She takes a breath. "May I show you what I've worked out?"

image.comp: sitting on the edge of a bed twisting her sleeve in her lap, looking up with shy brave eyes
image.setting: her bedroom at night, one candle, drawn curtains

2.goRes: It turns out she worked out quite a lot. She apologizes for none of it.
2.waitRes: "Oh. That's nice too," she says, and means it. "A little longer, then, before I show you."

2.title: {name}: A Dare
2.text: {name} slaps a coin down on Sam's desk. "Heads, I pick the next thing we do. Tails, you do." She flips it, catches it, and doesn't look at it. "Heads," she says, with a grin that says it never mattered. "I pick something past kissing."

image.comp: flipping a coin and catching it, grinning, stepping into his space with confident heat
image.setting: his small study at night, lantern on the desk

2.goRes: She never did look at the coin. He suspects it had two heads.
2.waitRes: She laughs and flips again. It lands on the floor. She drags him down to look, and then doesn't let him up for a while, kissing instead.

2.title: {name}: After the Last Guest
2.text: The last guest has gone, and {name} sits on a stool by the dying fire, boots off, rolling her sore shoulders. Sam brings her a cup of tea, and she holds his wrist so the cup trembles. "Everyone takes what they want from me and goes," she says, very quietly. "You always bring tea. Stay a while. I'd like to give something to you."

image.comp: sitting by a dying fire with her boots off, holding his wrist, soft vulnerable smile
image.setting: house parlor after the last guest, embers glowing

2.goRes: She gives, and he receives, and it is the opposite of work.
2.waitRes: They share the pot until it goes cold, her head on his knee. "Next time," she says, drowsy, and means it.

3.title: {name}: Stay Tonight
3.text: {name} is waiting in Sam's room when he comes up, lamp turned low. "I don't want to say goodnight at the door again," she says. "Stay with me tonight."

image.comp: sitting on the edge of a bed in lamplight, holding out a hand to him, soft determined smile
image.setting: his bedroom at night, lamp turned low

3.goRes: The lamp burns down. Neither of them gets up to refill it.
3.waitRes: {name} nods slowly. "Okay. But I'm not going anywhere."

3.title: {name}: The Whole Night
3.text: {name} takes Sam's hand and leads him upstairs without a word. At her door she finally looks back. "I'm sure," she says, before he can ask.

image.comp: leading him by the hand up a narrow staircase, looking back over her shoulder, sure gentle smile
image.setting: narrow lantern-lit staircase at night

3.waitRes: "I said so." She sighs, fond. "Ask me again next week, then. I'll say the same thing."

3.title: {name}: Done Waiting
3.text: {name} kicks Sam's door shut behind her. "I've been patient," she says. "I'm finished being patient."

image.comp: kicking a bedroom door shut, pulling off her outer layer, fierce grin
image.setting: his bedroom at night

3.goRes: Neither of them is patient about it.
3.waitRes: "So is honesty." She grins and leaves. "Honestly, you'll regret that."

3.title: {name}: Gently
3.text: {name} is nervous and won't pretend she isn't. "I want this," she says, holding both his hands. "Just... gently. Okay?"

image.comp: holding both of his hands beside a candlelit bed, nervous brave expression
image.setting: small candlelit bedroom

3.goRes: It is gentle. It's also wonderful, and afterward she won't stop smiling.
3.wait: "We have all the time in the world."
3.waitRes: She lets out a long breath and laughs. "Okay. Okay. Thank you."

3.title: {name}: An Invitation
3.text: A note under Sam's door, in elegant handwriting: "My room. Midnight. Don't be late." When he arrives, {name} is waiting, perfectly composed, except for her eyes.

image.comp: standing by a candlelit window at midnight in an elegant robe, perfectly composed, looking at him with intent
image.setting: elegant bedroom at midnight, candles

3.goRes: Her composure lasts about a minute. It's a very good minute.
3.waitRes: "Then thank you for being punctual." A faint smile. "Another midnight."

3.title: {name}: The One That Counts
3.text: {name} closes her door behind them and leans against it. "Half this town thinks they know what I'm like in bed," she says. "I want one person who doesn't have to guess."

image.comp: leaning back against her closed bedroom door, looking at him, vulnerable and certain
image.setting: her bedroom late at night, a single candle

3.goRes: None of it is new to her, and all of it is. She tells him so, afterward.
3.waitRes: They don't do anything but lie there. {name} says it's the most intimate night she's had in years.

3.title: {name}: Morning After Rain
3.text: The rain hasn't stopped since yesterday, and {name} appears at Sam's door with a blanket around her shoulders and her hair damp. "I don't want to hear it on my own roof tonight," she says. "I want to hear it on yours." She steps inside without waiting for an answer.

image.comp: standing in his doorway wrapped in a blanket with damp hair, soft earnest smile
image.setting: his bedroom at night, rain on the window, lamp burning low

3.goRes: The rain keeps up all night. Neither of them hears it after a while.
3.wait: "It's late. Let me walk you back"
3.waitRes: She laughs, gentle and flustered. "Walk me back, then. Slowly." She takes his arm and it is a very long walk.

3.title: {name}: Ink and Candlelight
3.text: {name} has written Sam a letter. She holds it, folded, against her chest. "I couldn't say it right," she says. "So I wrote it. It's long. It ends with an invitation." She presses the page into his hand. The last line is just three words: "Stay with me."

image.comp: standing at his table, pressing a folded letter into his hand, cheeks flushed, steady gaze
image.setting: his study at night, candlelight, ink pot and quill

3.goRes: He never gets to the second page until morning.
3.waitRes: "Do. Take your time." She touches his sleeve. "I'll be here, reading you."

3.title: {name}: Mine Tonight
3.text: {name} lifts the key to his bedroom from the hook by the stairs, tosses it once, and catches it. "I've decided you're mine tonight," she says. "The house can run itself. Think of it as a day off." She looks as pleased as a cat with cream. Her eyes are not teasing at all.

image.comp: tossing a key and catching it, leaning on his door frame, purring smile
image.setting: upstairs hallway, his bedroom door, lantern light

3.goRes: She locks the door and drops the key down her front. He is clearly not leaving until morning.
3.waitRes: "It really doesn't," she says, and sighs. "Fine. But the key stays with me."

3.title: {name}: Dress Rehearsal
3.text: {name} stands in his doorway in a gown she bought last week and has not yet been seen in. She turns once, slowly, and the silk catches the lamp. "I wanted you to be the first to see it," she says. "And I wanted you to be the one who takes it off." She says it with perfect, courteous composure, and her hands are shaking.

image.comp: turning slowly in an elegant gown in his doorway, poised, steady gaze despite trembling hands
image.setting: his bedroom at night, lamplight on silk

3.goRes: He does, slowly. The gown, it turns out, was very well made.
3.wait: "It's beautiful. Keep it on a while"
3.waitRes: "Then I shall," she says, with a regal nod and the first real smile of the night.

jump.title: {name}: All at Once
jump.text: {name} kisses Sam for the first time in the hallway, and then again, and then she's pulling him toward her door. "I don't want to do this in pieces," she says.

image.comp: pulling him toward her bedroom door by the hand, flushed, kissing him over her shoulder
image.setting: lantern-lit upstairs hallway at night

jump.goRes: One kiss turns into a great deal more than a kiss.
jump.waitRes: {name} stops, catches her breath, and laughs. "...Okay. Slower. Annoyingly."

jump.title: {name}: No Half Measures
jump.text: "I don't do things halfway," {name} says, closing Sam's door behind her. "Never have."

image.comp: leaning back against a closed door, confident heated gaze at him
image.setting: his bedroom at night, one lamp

jump.waitRes: She laughs. "Fine. A quarter. For now."

jump.title: {name}: Something Shifts
jump.text: Sam is helping {name} carry linens upstairs when she drops them all, takes his face in her hands, and kisses him. When she pulls back, she doesn't let go. "Come with me," she whispers.

image.comp: holding his face in her hands in a hallway, fallen linens around their feet, breathless
image.setting: upstairs hallway, scattered white linens, lantern light

jump.goRes: The linens stay on the floor until morning.
jump.waitRes: "Forget the linens." But she lets him go, laughing. "Next time, forget them faster."

jump.title: {name}: Skipping Ahead
jump.text: "I've never been good at the slow part," {name} admits, already pulling Sam toward her room. "But I'm going to remember this one. Is that all right?"

image.comp: pulling him by the hand toward her room, laughing and a little shy
image.setting: her bedroom doorway at night, lamplight

jump.goRes: She does remember it. So does he.
jump.waitRes: {name} stops in the doorway, considers this, and kisses his cheek instead. "Fine. Slow. Tomorrow."

jump.title: {name}: Storm Night
jump.text: Thunder cracks over the house and every lamp flickers. {name} knocks on Sam's door in her nightgown, clutching a pillow. "I'm not scared," she says, as the next crack shakes the windows. "I just don't want to be alone." She looks at him, then at the bed, then at him again, and steps close enough that the question changes.

image.comp: clutching a pillow in his doorway in a nightgown, lightning behind her, stepping close
image.setting: his bedroom during a thunderstorm, flickering lamp

jump.goRes: The storm passes eventually. Neither of them was paying attention.
jump.waitRes: "The chair," she repeats, deadpan, and laughs. "Very gentlemanly." She takes the pillow back to bed, but keeps the door open a crack.

jump.title: {name}: Wine and Nerve
jump.text: {name} has had exactly one glass of wine, enough to be brave and not enough to be silly. She sets it down, stands, and crosses the room to Sam in four steps. "I'm going to kiss you," she says, "and then I'm going to ask for more. Tell me now if that is a mistake."

image.comp: crossing a room toward him with a determined stride, empty wine glass left behind, bright eyes
image.setting: private sitting room at night, wine bottle on the table

jump.goRes: It was the opposite of a mistake, and she says so several times between kisses.
jump.waitRes: She blinks, then smiles, and sits right back down. "Reasonable. I'll sleep on it. Don't let me lose my nerve."

jump.title: {name}: Long Time Coming
jump.text: {name} has rehearsed this in her head for weeks, and she gets it all wrong anyway. She starts the speech, forgets the middle, and abandons it entirely. "I'm terrible at this," she says, laughing and a little teary. "Can I skip to the part where I don't talk anymore?"

image.comp: laughing and flustered in his doorway, fingers on his sleeve, eyes bright
image.setting: hallway outside his room at night, lantern light

jump.goRes: She does, and it is nothing like her rehearsal, and far better.
jump.waitRes: She takes a breath, tries again, and still forgets the middle, and he loves every second of it.

pent_1.title: {name} Can't Stand It
pent_1.text: {name} has been restless for days and she's done hiding it. She catches Sam in the stairwell, pins him to the wall with both hands, and kisses him before he can say a word.

image.comp: pinning him against a stairwell wall with both hands, flushed, restless heated eyes
image.setting: narrow lantern-lit stairwell

pent_1.goRes: When she finally lets him go, they're both out of breath.
pent_1.waitRes: She groans and thumps her forehead against his shoulder. "Sorry. It's been a week."

pent_1.title: {name} Is Out of Patience
pent_1.text: {name} has been pacing the corridor outside Sam's door for what feels like an hour, and when he opens it she doesn't speak, only grips his lapels and kisses him, hard and a little desperate. "I'm sorry," she says into his mouth. "I'm not sorry. I've thought about this too much."

image.comp: gripping his lapels in a doorway, kissing him hard, flushed restless eyes
image.setting: his doorway at night, corridor lantern

pent_1.goRes: She apologizes again, between kisses, and means it even less.
pent_1.waitRes: She presses her face into his shoulder and breathes. "Okay. Okay. Just give me a minute. A long one."

pent_1.title: {name}: The Last Straw
pent_1.text: It's the way {name} watches him sort the linens that does it, her gaze lingering on his hands. She puts the basket down, shuts the laundry room door, and leans on it. "I've held out as long as I can," she says. "Please don't make me do it from across the room."

image.comp: leaning on a closed laundry room door, breathing a little fast, intense gaze
image.setting: laundry room, hanging sheets, afternoon light

pent_1.goRes: She meets him halfway, and the sheets sway above them.
pent_1.waitRes: She exhales a sharp, frustrated laugh. "Fine. Not here. Somewhere with a lock, then. Soon."

pent_2.title: {name} Has Waited Long Enough
pent_2.text: Kissing isn't cutting it anymore, and {name} says so, at length, while pulling Sam into the nearest empty room.

image.comp: pulling him into an empty room by his hoodie, impatient flushed grin
image.setting: small empty guest room, afternoon light

pent_2.goRes: She's very clear about what she wants. Sam is happy to oblige.
pent_2.waitRes: She lets go with a frustrated sigh. "Fine. But I'm not waiting forever."

pent_2.title: {name}: No More Kisses
pent_2.text: "Kissing isn't enough," {name} says, holding Sam's wrists against the stair rail, pupils wide. "It was never going to be enough. Do you know how many nights I've spent counting the steps to your door?" Her voice is rough, and her whole body hums.

image.comp: pinning his wrists lightly against a stair rail, intense flushed gaze, breathing fast
image.setting: back staircase of the house, evening light

pent_2.goRes: She takes the lead, and all the counted steps are finally worth it.
pent_2.waitRes: She makes an agonized sound and rests her forehead on his chest. "I'm trying. Hold me while I try."

pent_2.title: {name}: Past Caring
pent_2.text: {name} has been on edge since breakfast, and by the afternoon she has stopped pretending otherwise. She walks into Sam's office, turns the key, and leans back against the desk. "I'm not going to be subtle," she says. "I want you. Now. Please."

image.comp: leaning back against his desk with the door locked behind her, wanting gaze, flushed
image.setting: his office in the afternoon, sunlight through the curtains

pent_2.goRes: The ledgers are going to need reshuffling.
pent_2.waitRes: "After the shift," she repeats, agonized, and kisses him once, savagely, to hold him to it.

pent_3.title: {name} Has Had Enough
pent_3.text: {name} shows up at Sam's door at midnight, restless and done pretending otherwise. "I've been lying awake for a week," she says. "Let me in."

image.comp: standing in a doorway at midnight in a loose nightgown, restless heated eyes, one hand on the frame
image.setting: dark hallway at midnight, candlelight

pent_3.waitRes: She exhales hard. "Tomorrow. I'm holding you to it."

pent_3.title: {name}: Not Another Night
pent_3.text: {name} stands at Sam's bedside in the dark, one hand on the blanket. "I can't sleep. I can't think. I can't do anything but want you." Her voice cracks, unashamed. "Please. I'd rather say it plainly than pretend I don't."

image.comp: standing at the side of his bed in the dark, hand on the blanket, raw and unashamed
image.setting: his bedroom in the small hours, a single candle

pent_3.goRes: She slides in beside him, and the long week ends right there.
pent_3.waitRes: She tells him, haltingly and then fluently, and it is the most honest conversation they have ever had.

pent_3.title: {name}: Undone
pent_3.text: {name} meets Sam on the landing, flushed and bare-footed, and takes his face in her hands. "I've tried everything," she says. "Cold water. Long walks. Counting. I'm out of tricks, Sam. I'm just out." She leans her forehead on his.

image.comp: cupping his face on a landing, bare-footed, forehead against his, breathless
image.setting: upstairs landing at night, a single lantern

pent_3.goRes: She follows him in, and the tricks are forgotten.
pent_3.waitRes: "I won't sleep," she says, and sighs. "But I'll lie there and be good. For tonight."

pent_jump.title: {name} Can't Wait
pent_jump.text: {name} has been climbing the walls for days. Tonight she corners Sam, kisses him for the very first time, and doesn't stop at kissing.

image.comp: cornering him against a wall, kissing him hungrily, flushed restless expression
image.setting: dim corridor late at night

pent_jump.goRes: First kiss, and then everything else, in about that order.
pent_jump.waitRes: She stops, breathing hard. "...Sorry. I've been going crazy." She doesn't look very sorry.

pent_jump.title: {name}: Everything at Once
pent_jump.text: {name} bursts into Sam's room without knocking, shuts the door, and says, "I've been trying to work out how to start. I can't. So I'll start with this." She kisses him, then keeps going, in the order that seems right to her, which is every order at once.

image.comp: bursting through his door, kissing him with both hands in his hoodie, wild and flushed
image.setting: his bedroom at dusk, lantern light

pent_jump.goRes: It happens, in an order only she understands.
pent_jump.waitRes: She gasps, steadies, and laughs. "Okay. Breathing. Don't go anywhere."

pent_jump.title: {name}: Past Waiting
pent_jump.text: "I'm not going to wait for a good moment," {name} says, catching Sam in the hall and pushing him against the wall with no ceremony. "There isn't one. There's only this one." Her eyes are fierce and her hands are very sure.

image.comp: pushing him against a hallway wall, fierce eyes, hands sure on his chest
image.setting: house hallway in the evening, lantern light

pent_jump.waitRes: "Slower," she says, and tries, and fails, and kisses him until it's only a very fast sort of slow.
